fact: On 22 July 2024 the BCEAO started the pilot of the UEMOA interoperable instant payment system with 25 institutions, three of them in Guinea-Bissau (Banco da União, Ecobank, Orabank).
title: Démarrage de la phase pilote du système de paiement instantané interopérable de l'Union Economique et Monétaire Ouest Africaine
